bar.name: v1 HTML fixtures and A2UI for the same apps; 300 blind English requests; independent end-to-end attack on stored rows

biggest_gap: The new-install exception checks only table rows, so an app whose data lives in settings or states (zakat calculator, counter) accepts another app's backup and is replaced with ok:true. Pick values also reach the UI tree as raw {o:slot} objects.

acceptance.line: >= 90% of 300 blind requests expressible (programs parse and type-check)
acceptance.evidence: mo.mjs check: 30 examples and 303 corpus files, 0 failures. Coverage of unseen requests not re-measured.
300 corpus programs: keyword tokenizer median 133, p90 239, max 811.

acceptance.line: every prefix cut at a line end parses
acceptance.evidence: prefix.test.mjs 70/70; fuzz-check 20,000 mutations on two fresh seeds: 0 crashes.

acceptance.line: edits never lose or retype saved data while marked safe
acceptance.evidence: Rename core held: critic's 80k-step slot fuzz and 150 hand sequences found no lost, moved or merged value. Open: foreign backup overwrites a settings-only app (S1); {o:slot} leaks into tree and edit sheet, echo saves '[object Object]' (S2); data Undo after restore (S2).

other_notes: S2: restore() clears version Undo but not the data Undo stack, so undo() brings back rows from before the restore. S2: data Undo after an edit that added a setting leaves that setting without its default until reload.

S3: a choice change with an unknown option sets the stored value to null; restore returns no count of what it replaced; a snapshot without an app id is accepted anywhere; screen-level state picks are not slots; two installs of one program get different app ids.
Eight of nine round 6 faults confirmed fixed. Five hand-computed programs match the evaluator after renames and swaps.
